snippet.title: SIBIR - Official Shape-Shifter Gameplay Teaser (Indie Survival Horror)
snippet.description:
🏚️ Wishlist SIBIR on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3118840/Sibir/

Sibir is a first-person survival horror exploration game set in an abandoned Soviet-era bunker. In this gameplay clip, we dive into the K-7 facility to face off against anomalous objects that transform into nightmare creatures.

📻 Join the official Discord: https://discord.gg/kzg9eSqqtk

Developed in Godot 4.
